evidence_quotes.quote: 24mm steel spindle (compatible with Shimano Hollowtech II bottom brackets), 110BCD 4-bolt spider, Q-factor 147mm
Power accuracy ±1.5%, 200-hour battery life, IPX7 waterproof, weight ~650g (170mm without chainrings)
Spider lockring 35-40 Nm, left crank pinch bolt 12-14 Nm, preload cap 1-1.5 Nm, Magene chainring bolts 8 Nm; re-check torque after 100 km

adversarial_checks: Architecture truth check: Explicitly flagged that spider-based P505 measures true combined total power (±1.5%) while L/R balance is estimated rather than independent dual-leg strain gauges.
Torque sanity check: Distinguished spider lockring torque (35–40 Nm) from left crank pinch bolts (12–14 Nm) and Magene chainring bolts (8 Nm) to prevent stripping hazards.
BB & Base-kit check: Verified chainrings are excluded in Base kit and Trek BB90 / internal T47 clearance caveats are explicitly documented; asin set to null per SM-02.
